methods.description: Simplify like terms if needed, gather pronumerals on one side and apply inverse operations to both sides.
Multiply every term in each bracket by its outside number, collect like terms and gather pronumerals if needed before solving.
For a whole bracket multiplied by a number, divide both sides by that number first, then undo the operations inside.
Identify where a negative outside number was not multiplied by every term, correct that expansion and continue solving.
